project_name: Vendor Onboarding & Master Data Management Portal

core_principles: Authority and Clarity: Information hierarchy is paramount. The design must handle high data density (SAP codes, compliance numbers) without cognitive overload.
Progressive Disclosure: Multi-step onboarding must reveal complexity only as the vendor advances. Do not overwhelm with all fields at once.
Functional Aesthetics: Color is strictly functional (Red = Error, Green = Verified/Approved, Blue = Action). Avoid decorative gradients.
The 'Control Room' Vibe: Reviewer, Approver, and SAP Team dashboards must feel like a high-precision command center. Flat surfaces, crisp borders, no heavy drop shadows.
anti_patterns: No center-aligned dense forms. Always left-align inputs and labels.
No 'Bootstrap' standard tables. Use highly customized, dense Shadcn tables with tight padding.
Do not use generic sans-serif fonts for headings. 'Inter' is banned for headings.

headings.usage: H1-H4 headings, dashboard titles, onboarding step titles. Use tracking-tight for sizes above 32px.

body.usage: Paragraphs, form labels, table data, general UI text. Provides excellent legibility for dense technical interfaces.

monospace.usage: Use strictly for regulatory and system data: GSTIN, PAN, TAN, IFSC, SWIFT, IBAN, SAP Company Codes, Account Groups.

hierarchy_rules.mono_data: font-mono text-sm text-slate-900 bg-slate-100 px-1.5 py-0.5 rounded-md border border-slate-200

dashboard_grid.structure: grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-4 lg:grid-cols-12 gap-4 or gap-6
dashboard_grid.widget_rules: Summary metrics span 3 cols, main data tables span 9 or 12 cols. Use h-full to match neighbor heights.

multi_step_onboarding.sidebar: w-64 or w-80 fixed left sidebar showing visual progress checklist. bg-slate-50 border-r border-slate-200.
multi_step_onboarding.main_content: Max-width centered container (max-w-2xl) inside the remaining space. Generous padding (p-8 to p-12).

surface_treatment.cards: bg-white border border-slate-200 rounded-lg shadow-sm. NO heavy drop shadows. Sharp, technical feel.
surface_treatment.headers: Sticky top headers must use Crystal Glass: bg-white/70 backdrop-blur-xl border-b border-slate-200 z-50.
surface_treatment.inputs: Flat borders, h-10, slightly rounded (rounded-md). Focus state: ring-2 ring-primary/20 border-primary.

forms.validation: Instant inline validation. No post-submit error walls.
forms.layout: Labels above inputs. Group related fields in grid-cols-2 (e.g., First Name / Last Name).

tables.density: High density. py-2 px-3 for cells.
tables.features: Sticky headers, row hover states (hover:bg-slate-50), right-aligned numeric columns, status badges.

status_badges.Verified (Document): bg-emerald-50 text-emerald-700 border border-emerald-200 flex items-center gap-1 (include check icon)

icons.style: Regular or Duotone weight. Keep sizes consistent (w-4 h-4 for inline, w-5 h-5 for sidebar).

testing_attributes.rule: MANDATORY: All interactive elements must include 'data-testid' attributes.

login_screen_hero.description: Modern glass office building reflecting sky. Use on the right side of the split login screen with an overlay to maintain corporate feel.
login_screen_hero.overlay: bg-slate-900/40 or a slight blue tint gradient to ensure any overlaid text is readable.

dashboard_empty_state.description: Business professionals meeting. Use subtly in empty states or success screens.

instructions_to_main_agent: Do not use generic template styles. This is a robust enterprise portal.
Implement the multi-step form with a persistent left sidebar progress tracker.
For all regulatory and system IDs (GSTIN, PAN, SWIFT, SAP Codes), explicitly use the JetBrains Mono font class to prevent misreading characters.
Ensure the Reviewer and SAP Team tables are data-dense and actionable without requiring excessive clicks.
Use Shadcn UI components extensively but strip away any 'soft' borders or heavy drop shadows to fit the 'Swiss High-Contrast' archetype.
Always enforce the data-testid attributes for testing.
